anomalies.title: Unicode Invalid Characters Block JSON Serialization
anomalies.description: Codex sessions contained invalid unicode control characters (U+0000-U+001F) and surrogate pairs that break JSON serialization when sending to Xavier API.
anomalies.impact: Prevents indexing of Codex sessions without client-side sanitization
anomalies.evidence: PowerShell error: 'The request body was not formatted as valid Unicode.'
anomalies.workaround: JavaScript sanitization script strips control chars and surrogates
anomalies.root_cause: Codex CLI stores raw terminal output including escape sequences and control characters

anomalies.title: Security Scan API Response Format Mismatch
anomalies.description: Documentation says response contains {scanned, attack_type} but actual API returns {allowed, detection: {attack_type, confidence, is_injection}}.
anomalies.impact: Test suite failed until response format was reverse-engineered
anomalies.evidence: Test 'Security scan endpoint' failed with expected 'scanned' field not found
anomalies.workaround: Updated test to use actual response format
anomalies.root_cause: API documentation outdated or not synchronized with implementation

anomalies.title: No Path-Prefix Search Filter
anomalies.description: Memory search only supports semantic queries. Cannot filter by path prefix like 'cli-history/codex/*'.
anomalies.impact: Impossible to count indexed items by category without scanning all results
anomalies.evidence: Searching 'cli-history/codex' returned 0 results even though items exist
anomalies.workaround: Use semantic content queries instead of path queries
anomalies.root_cause: Search uses vector embeddings only, no path-based filtering

anomalies.title: False Positive Prompt Injection Detection on Code Content
anomalies.description: Security scanner blocks chunks containing code patterns (SQL, shell commands, prompt engineering examples) as potential indirect prompt injection.
anomalies.impact: Code-heavy CLI conversations cannot be fully indexed
anomalies.evidence: Multiple Codex chunks blocked despite being legitimate code
anomalies.workaround: Security scanner disabled or tuned for code content
anomalies.root_cause: Heuristic-based injection detector lacks context awareness

anomalies.title: OpenClaw Trajectory Format Complex to Parse
anomalies.description: OpenClaw stores events as trace objects (session.started, prompt.submitted, model.completed) rather than simple messages, requiring complex extraction logic.
anomalies.impact: Indexing script needs custom parser per CLI tool format
anomalies.evidence: JavaScript index-conversations.js required different logic for each tool
anomalies.workaround: Tool-specific extraction logic in indexing script
anomalies.root_cause: Each CLI tool uses different storage format with no standardization

anomalies.title: Body Size Limit Exceeded on Large Content
anomalies.description: Attempting to save large JSON benchmark report failed with 'Failed to buffer the request body: length limit exceeded'.
anomalies.impact: Cannot save large documents in single request
anomalies.evidence: Error when saving 3.9KB JSON file to memory/add
anomalies.workaround: Split content into smaller chunks or use summary instead
anomalies.root_cause: HTTP body size limit in server configuration

anomalies.title: Path Field Empty in Search Results
anomalies.description: Search results contain empty 'path' fields at top level, requiring content-based verification instead of path-based.
anomalies.impact: Cannot verify indexed items by their original path
anomalies.evidence: All search results showed 'path=' empty in debug output
anomalies.workaround: Include path in content or metadata for verification
anomalies.root_cause: Search response structure may not include path in all result types
